title: Smart DC Trends
description: Hub dashboard linking to all Smart DC Grafana trend dashboards. Embedded in Smart DC UI Trends menu (admin only).

options.content:
# Smart DC Trends

Select a dashboard below to view site-specific trends. All dashboards use **Asia/Singapore** timezone and default to the last 24 hours.

## Shared

- [Asset / Sensor Trends](/d/asset-sensor-trends/asset-sensor-trends) — Searchable multi-select asset and sensor trends with anomaly prediction overlay
- [Rule Version Status](/d/rule-version-status/rule-version-status) — Compare GBR rule versions across Dev and Prod environments
